<strong>Clasifica antes de resolver.</st: Classify before solving. Separable, linear, exact: each has its method and trying the wrong one costs ten minutes. Looking at the form of the equation is the first step, not the second.
<strong>En Fourier, mira primero la sime: In Fourier, look at the symmetry first. An odd function has no cosines and an even one has no sines: half the coefficients vanish without integrating anything.
<strong>La condición inicial va al final: The initial condition comes last, but it is not forgotten. A general solution with the constant undetermined answers half the question, and it is the commonest slip in the block.
<strong>Los equilibrios se encuentran ig: Equilibria are found by setting to zero and classified by differentiating. Without solving the equation you can say where the system is heading, and many questions ask exactly that.
Cada tramo aporta un número fijo de preg: Each section contributes a fixed number of questions, drawn at random from its topics without repeating a topic while that is possible, and avoiding the most basic exercises. Clasificar un oscilador por su amortigua: Classifying an oscillator by its damping; natural frequency and resonance; the equilibrium points of a system and their stability; the bifurcation diagram and when chaos appears.
Cómo sacarle partido: How to get the most out of it
El enlace de un examen corregido reprodu: The link to a marked exam reproduces the same questions with the same numbers. A teacher can do one, copy the link and pass it to the class: everyone will sit the same exam and will be able to compare results and procedures.

Es la frontera entre oscilar y arrastrar: It is the border between oscillating and crawling: any less damping produces a bounce and any more takes longer. That is why door closers are designed this way.
Eso es el amortiguamiento débil, por deb: That is light damping, below critical. At critical it does not cross the equilibrium even once.
Examen de ecuaciones diferenciales y ond: Exam on differential equations and waves
La ecuación del calor la escribió Fourie: Fourier wrote the heat equation in 1807 and the Paris academy rejected it: Lagrange would not accept that any function whatever could be written as a sum of sines. Fourier was right and the objection was partly right too, and clarifying exactly which part produced a good deal of nineteenth-century analysis. The questions in this section are the arithmetic of that argument.
Ocho temas cuya incógnita no es un númer: Eight topics whose unknown is not a number but a function. This topic teaches nothing new: it asks. A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block, with a clock and no hints, to know whether you can now tell which method each equation calls for and what the solution says about what the equation describes.
Oscila con amplitud decreciente hasta pa: It oscillates with decreasing amplitude until it stops
Reconocer la ecuación del calor o la de: Recognising the heat or the wave equation and what each does; the coefficients of a Fourier series; which frequencies a signal contains; convolving two short signals by hand.
Se mueve, y además es el caso que vuelve: It moves, and it is in fact the case that returns soonest. What it does not do is overshoot.
Se queda quieto: el amortiguamiento crít: It stays still: critical damping blocks the motion
Separar variables y resolver una lineal: Separating variables and solving a first-order linear equation; imposing the initial condition; taking one Euler or Runge-Kutta step and saying how the error grows with the step size.
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock paper taken at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the 8 topics of the block, spread across sections, and every time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submission everything is marked, the step-by-step solution of each question opens, and the mark comes out section by section, with links to what is worth revising. The “tailored to what you have done” option puts first what you have not solved yet: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
Un oscilador tiene amortiguamiento críti: An oscillator is critically damped. What does it do when released away from equilibrium?
Vuelve al equilibrio lo más rápido posib: It returns to equilibrium as fast as possible without overshooting
